title: AB-BA deadlocks between pipe and channel critical sections
raw_content: Deadlock occurs between nsPipe and nsHttpChannel critical sections when one thread writes to a pipe while holding channel lock and another thread holds the pipe lock waiting on the channel lock.

title: NullPointerException in ConsoleConsumer
raw_content: ConsoleConsumer throws NullPointerException when partition metadata contains null leader or when consumer stream iterator encounters uninitialized message payload.

title: unlimited socket timeout results in the connect timeout being used as a socket timeout
raw_content: When socket timeout is left unset or configured to zero, HttpClient mistakenly applies connect timeout to socket read operations, aborting long-running chunked data transfers prematurely.

title: json2sstable fails due to OutOfMemory
raw_content: Importing large JSON files into SSTables loads all partition rows into Java heap memory at once, causing OutOfMemoryError for files larger than JVM heap space.

title: CVS Authentication error: says name/password wrong when really path wrong
raw_content: When connecting to remote repository with invalid server repository path, authentication handler misidentifies the 401/unauthorized error as invalid credentials rather than bad path.

title: Minor cosmetic typo in user profile settings navigation header

title: Deadlock detected during simultaneous inventory reservation and warehouse sync
